name: augmentor-packs
description: Augmentor plugins for Claude Code: packs that coach, scaffold, check, and accelerate your own work instead of replacing it, plus optional key-free MCP tool add-ons.

plugins.name: student-augmentor
plugins.description: Academic-integrity-aware study coach: Socratic tutoring, syllabus-to-study-plan, flashcards and spaced repetition, essay coaching (never ghostwriting), source evaluation and citation checks, exam prep, level-adjusted explanations, and math/code step-checking.

plugins.name: office-augmentor
plugins.description: Knowledge-work co-pilot: inbox triage and reply drafts, meeting prep and notes-to-actions, document/report drafting, spreadsheet formulas and analysis, slide outlines, stakeholder updates, SOPs, and polite-pushback/negotiation coaching. Drafts only; you send.

plugins.name: ai-transition-builder
plugins.description: For people with some technical background moving into building with AI: prompt engineering, agentic workflow design, LLM APIs, RAG, evals, shipping a prototype, a learning roadmap, reviewing AI-generated code, and LLM app security.

plugins.name: educator-augmentor
plugins.description: Planning and feedback co-pilot for teachers: standards-aligned lesson and unit plans (you supply the standards), differentiation/UDL, rubrics, assessments, feedback suggestions on student work (you stay the grader), parent communication, and classroom AI policy.

plugins.name: solo-founder-augmentor
plugins.description: Sparring partner for solo founders: positioning and offer, customer discovery scripts and synthesis, pricing, landing page copy, outreach drafts, weekly CEO review, runway math, SOPs/delegation, and a decision journal.

plugins.name: healthcare-worker-augmentor
plugins.description: Communication and study co-pilot for nurses and allied health: SBAR/handoff structure, plain-language patient education, documentation clarity, drug-info question prep that defers to official references and the pharmacist, shift/burnout planning, and CE study. Not medical advice; never paste PHI.

plugins.name: trades-augmentor
plugins.description: Back-office and study co-pilot for electricians, plumbers, HVAC techs, and contractors: job scoping, quotes from your own rates, customer messages, code-lookup prep that defers to the adopted code and AHJ, safety checklists, invoicing, scheduling, and licensing exam study.

plugins.name: job-seeker-augmentor
plugins.description: Honest job-search coach: resume tailoring without fabrication, interview prep and mock interviews, STAR story bank, networking drafts you send, offer negotiation with your own data, an application tracker, and a skills-gap plan.

plugins.name: creator-augmentor
plugins.description: Creative sparring partner for creators: ideation, hooks and scripts in your voice, repurposing, editorial calendar, audience research from your exports, sponsorship pitches with your real metrics, analytics review, and a voice guide. Never posts.

plugins.name: parent-caregiver-augmentor
plugins.description: Co-pilot for parents and family caregivers: family logistics and meal planning, a homework coach that doesn't give answers, school and doctor message drafts, aging-parent appointment prep, a care log, benefits/legal question checklists that defer to professionals, and self-care.

plugins.name: tools-package-health
plugins.description: Optional MCP tool add-on: npm and PyPI package metadata, maintenance signals, and known vulnerabilities from OSV.dev, plus a one-shot health verdict. No API key. Runs a local zero-dependency Node.js stdio server.

plugins.name: tools-github-releases
plugins.description: Optional MCP tool add-on: list GitHub releases, read the latest release notes, and build a changelog between two tags via api.github.com. No key required; an optional GITHUB_TOKEN from your environment raises rate limits.

plugins.name: tools-holidays-nager
plugins.description: Optional MCP tool add-on: public holidays by country (Nager.Date) and business-day math (is it a working day, add N business days, count business days between dates). No API key.

plugins.name: tools-sec-edgar
plugins.description: Optional MCP tool add-on: look up US public companies on SEC EDGAR — latest filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K), key annual financials, and XBRL concept history. No API key; sends a configurable User-Agent as SEC requires.

plugins.name: tools-domain-checks
plugins.description: Optional MCP tool add-on: DNS records via Cloudflare DNS-over-HTTPS, RDAP registration and expiry, and TLS certificate expiry for a domain. No API key.
